title: PolicyDecision
description: Internal cryptographic policy decision generated by the Rust Policy Gate. Bound immutably to the exact request payload and method.

bound_request_digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the bound request parameters (method, url, body)

decision_nonce.description: Cryptographic single-use nonce binding this decision to the exact request

rule_matched.description: Name of the specific policy boundary rule matched

PolicyAction.description: Permitted policy actions determined by the Policy Gate.

oneOf.description: Request meets all safety boundaries and budgets; execution permitted
Request violates authorization contract, scope, or destination boundary
Request temporarily throttled due to rate or concurrency budget saturation
Request targets an elevated or high-risk operation requiring human sign-off
Emergency stop condition triggered; all active testing halted
